context: Search, in this order: /Users/joe/.skill-sync/skills (canonical source), /Users/joe/.claude including CLAUDE.md and any settings or hook files, /Users/joe/.codex, this repo's _project/handoffs and docs, and .jsonl transcripts under /Users/joe/.claude/projects as a separate targeted pass. Classify every hit as (a) a durable reusable instruction that can be edited, (b) a one-off historical task instruction in a transcript, or (c) text originating from an external harness. Correct (a) to require the effective human identity and to forbid agent Co-Authored-By / *-Session trailers. For (b) and (c), do NOT fabricate a code fix: record that the source was task-local or external and state what would be needed to stop it. Regenerate any skill mirror only through `make skill-sync`; never hand-edit a mirror.
description: A local agent session was observed executing `git config user.email noreply@anthropic.com && git config user.name Claude` inside /Users/joe/Developer/BenchBox.pool-09, which (see worktree-scoped-git-identity-at-claim) writes into the primary clone's shared config. The instruction came from task text, not from repo code: agent_instruction_audit.py only DETECTS the identity, and the only repo-side `git config user.*` writes are CI workflows setting benchbox-bot / github-actions[bot] in ephemeral CI checkouts. This item finds and corrects any DURABLE copy of that instruction so it stops being re-executed. Two search defects in the prior investigation must be corrected. First, the sweep excluded --glob '!*.jsonl' while the only confirmed evidence lived in a .jsonl transcript, so the search excluded its own evidence class. Second, it searched /Users/joe/.claude and /Users/joe/.codex but NOT /Users/joe/.skill-sync/skills, which is the canonical skill SOURCE and the single highest-value location: a copy there propagates into every generated mirror in every project. Scope note: the canonical skill source lives outside this repository, so that edit is an out-of-repo action recorded in the report, and only in-repo surfaces (handoffs, docs, AGENTS.md) are in this item's file scope.

anti_patterns.dont: Exclude .jsonl from the search because the files are large
anti_patterns.instead: Run transcripts as a separate targeted pass with a narrow pattern
anti_patterns.why: The only confirmed evidence of the writer lives in a .jsonl transcript; excluding it hides the evidence class that produced the finding

anti_patterns.instead: Edit the canonical source under /Users/joe/.skill-sync/skills and run make skill-sync
anti_patterns.why: They are generated mirrors; a hand edit is silently reverted by the next make skill-sync and breaks skill-sync-verify

anti_patterns.dont: Invent a local hook or fabricate a code fix when no durable writer is found
anti_patterns.instead: Report that the source was task-local or external, and record precisely what external change would stop it
anti_patterns.why: The confirmed writer was an agent following task text; inventing a mechanism would encode a false root cause and leave the real supply untouched

anti_patterns.dont: Treat this cleanup as closing the recurrence
anti_patterns.instead: Rely on worktree-scoped-git-identity-at-claim for prevention and treat this item as reducing avoidable re-execution
anti_patterns.why: The instruction text originates from an external agent harness that is still in service and will keep emitting it

preserves.behavior: Existing handoff documents keep their historical record; corrections are additive or targeted, not a rewrite of history
Generated skill mirrors remain byte-identical to what make skill-sync produces from the canonical source
The documented escape hatches stay available: BENCHBOX_ALLOW_AGENT_GIT_IDENTITY and BENCHBOX_ALLOW_AGENT_COAUTHOR for a task that explicitly authorized that exact identity or trailer

verifications.description: Unfixed-tree gate: no LIVE instruction surface tells an agent to set a vendor noreply identity. Deliberately excludes _project/handoffs (historical records may quote the command as evidence) and the todo-db export (item prose is self-matching).
verifications.expected: no live instruction surface directs an agent to set an agent/service identity

verifications.description: Generated mirrors match their canonical source and lock, and verify actually ran rather than skipping
verifications.expected: non-zero exit if skill-sync-verify fails OR if it prints a 'skipping' line, since a skip is not a pass
